If your order includes expedited shipping and was placed before 12pm EST, it may ship out the same day.If you’d like me to check your specific order status, just share your order number or the email address you used at checkout. turns.replyTail: You saidCan I reroute the package to a different address?Agent saidWe’re able to update the shipping address only if the new address stays within the same ZIP code. We can’t reroute a package to a different ZIP code, state, or country once the order is submitted.If your package has already shipped or is marked as delivered, it can no longer be rerouted. If you need help with your order, please let me know your order number or the email address you used, and I’ll check what options are available.
